meta.scope: D-only descriptive county-event dynamics; no predictive or causal evaluation
meta.type_definition: Outcome-blind county geo/context structure, including historical reliability; continuous structure partitioned into six coarse types, not natural categories or purely physical geography
meta.weather_tie_rule: earliest maximum for alignment; first/last maxima retained for lag uncertainty

peak_status_codes.0: varying weather with a defined peak

meta.cold_definition: negative temperature; a maximum is the coolest hour, not necessarily freezing or hazardous
meta.phase_loop_definition: Before/after peak within +/-24h and forecast hours, matched in four bins of each county-event weather range; at least two observed hours per branch
meta.phase_loop_caution: Stock accumulation, restoration lag, elapsed phase, prior stock and other weather can generate the loop; net stock changes are not failure rates
meta.lag_caution: Observed outage and weather peak intervals in the fixed window; not propagation speed, damage time, or a causal delay
meta.weights: Trimmed existing D county-event design weights, normalized only within each descriptive cohort and valid lag; raw weights retained in cache
meta.missingness: Out-of-window and unobserved hours remain missing; each curve reports its changing observed denominator

uncertainty.method: whole merged-event-group bootstrap within each descriptive cohort
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional on these weather anchors and county types; descriptive pointwise intervals, no multiplicity correction or significance gate

gust.intensity_definition: D design-weighted weather-only thirds among varying/defined peaks; no outcome-based threshold
